arxiv-2203-08284.title: Minimizing Trust with Exclusively-Used Physically-Isolated Hardware
arxiv-2203-08284.creator: Zhihao Yao , Seyed Mohammadjavad Seyed Talebi, Mingyi Chen, Ardalan Amiri Sani, Thomas Anderson
arxiv-2203-08284.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhihao Yao , Seyed Mohammadjavad Seyed Talebi, Mingyi Chen, Ardalan Amiri Sani, Thomas Anderson. Smartphone owners often need to run security-critical programs on the same device as other untrusted and potentially malicious programs. This requires users to trust hardware and system software to correctly sandbox malicious programs, trust that is often misplaced. Our goal is to minimize the number and complexity of hardware and software components that a smartphone owner needs to trust to withstand adversarial inputs.

arxiv-2206-01170.title: Hermite’s Identity and the Quadratic Reciprocity Law
arxiv-2206-01170.creator: Franz Lemmermeyer
arxiv-2206-01170.description: Abstract In this note we give a proof of the quadratic reciprocity law based on Gauss’s Lemma and Hermite’s identity. Let p=2m+1 and q=2n+1 be odd primes, and let A=\{1,2,\ldots m\} and B=\{1,2,\ldots n\} denote two half systems modulo p and q , respectively.

arxiv-2401-12979.title: GALA: Generating Animatable Layered Assets from a Single Scan
arxiv-2401-12979.creator: Taeksoo Kim 1 Byungjun Kim 1 Shunsuke Saito 2 Hanbyul Joo 1 and 1 Seoul National University 2 Codec Avatars Lab, Meta and {taeksu98, byungun.kim, hbjoo}@snu.ac.kr shunsukesaito@meta.com https://snuvclab.github.io/gala/
arxiv-2401-12979.description: Abstract We present GALA , a framework that takes as input a single-layer clothed 3D human mesh and decomposes it into complete multi-layered 3D assets. The outputs can then be combined with other assets to create novel clothed human avatars with any pose.

arxiv-2405-07731.title: The Edge of Random Tensor Eigenvalues with Deviation
arxiv-2405-07731.creator: Nicolas Delporte, Naoki Sasakura
arxiv-2405-07731.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicolas Delporte, Naoki Sasakura. The largest eigenvalue of random tensors is an important feature of systems involving disorder, equivalent to the ground state energy of glassy systems or to the injective norm of quantum states.

arxiv-2507-11832.title: ILID: Native Script Language Identification for Indian Languages
arxiv-2507-11832.creator: Yash Ingle, Pruthwik Mishra
arxiv-2507-11832.description: Abstract The language identification task is a crucial fundamental step in NLP. Often it serves as a pre-processing step for widely used NLP applications such as multilingual machine translation, information retrieval, question and answering, and text summarization. The core challenge of language identification lies in distinguishing languages in noisy, short, and code-mixed environments.

arxiv-2511-18760.title: HERMES: Towards Efficient and Verifiable Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
arxiv-2511-18760.creator: Azim Ospanov, Zijin Feng, Jiacheng Sun, Haoli Bai, Xin Shen, Farzan Farnia
arxiv-2511-18760.description: Abstract Informal mathematics has been central to modern large language model (LLM) reasoning, offering flexibility and enabling efficient construction of arguments. However, purely informal reasoning is prone to logical gaps and subtle errors that are difficult to detect and correct.

arxiv-2512-13227.title: Better LMO-based Momentum Methods with Second-Order Information
arxiv-2512-13227.creator: Sarit Khirirat, Abdurakhmon Sadiev, Yury Demidovich
arxiv-2512-13227.description: Abstract The use of momentum in stochastic optimization algorithms has shown empirical success across a range of machine learning tasks. Recently, a new class of stochastic momentum algorithms has emerged within the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) framework–leading to state-of-the-art methods, such as Muon, Scion, and Gluon, that effectively solve deep neural network training problems.

pmc-10705896.title: Exploring Safety Culture in the ICU of a Large Acute Teaching Hospital through Triangulating Different Data Sources
pmc-10705896.creator: Ellen Liston, Enda O’Connor, Marie E Ward, Federico Longhini, Dorit Nitzan
pmc-10705896.description: Safety Culture (SC) has become a key priority for safety improvement in healthcare. Studies have identified links between positive SC and improved patient outcomes. Mixed-method measurements of SC are needed to account for diverse social, cultural, and subcultural contexts within different healthcare settings.

pmc-11544834.title: Non-Conventional Brewers’ Spent Grains, an Alternative Raw Material in Bread-Making
pmc-11544834.creator: Mariana-Liliana Păcală, Alexandrina Sîrbu, Anca Șipoș, Wenhao Li
pmc-11544834.description: The main objective of this experiment was to investigate the technological potential of upcycling unsparged non-conventional brewers’ spent grains (BSGs) in bread-making and assess the comparative quality of bread enriched with non-fermented and lactic acid-fermented BSGs obtained from mashes brewed with starch adjuncts of buckwheat and oats.

pmc-12653843.title: Handheld Nonthermal Plasma Augmentation of Glass–Ceramic Spray Deposition on Zirconia Surface Characterization and MG-63/HGF-1 Cell Behavior: An In Vitro Study
pmc-12653843.creator: Sheng-Han Wu, Szu-Yu Lai, I-Ta Lee, Yuichi Mine, Huei-Yu Huang, Tzu-Yu Peng, Ramkumar Yadav, Anoj Meena, Daniele Botticelli
pmc-12653843.description: Zirconia is widely used for customized implant abutments owing to its esthetics, strength, and biocompatibility; however, the optimal surface modification for soft-tissue sealing and bone metabolic remains uncertain. This study evaluated how glass–ceramic spray deposition (GCSD), with or without handheld nonthermal plasma (HNP), alters zirconia surface physiochemistry and cellular responses.

pmc-12744822.title: A Novel Exon Duplication in the SACS Gene in Charlevoix-Saguenay Ataxia and a Summary of Polish Cases
pmc-12744822.creator: Jakub P Fichna, Ewelina Elert-Dobkowska, Wiktoria Radziwonik-Fraczyk, Karolina Ziora-Jakutowicz, Michalina Maria Wężyk, Mariusz Berdyński, Jacek Zaremba, Cezary Żekanowski, Małgorzata Bednarska-Makaruk
pmc-12744822.description: Mutations in the SACS gene are associated with autosomal recessive spastic ataxia of Charlevoix-Saguenay (ARSACS), a clinically and genetically heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorder. ARSACS typically manifests as slowly progressive ataxia with spasticity and sensorimotor neuropathy. Nevertheless, an array of additional features may also be observed, including hearing impairment, epileptic seizures, and even the absence of spasticity.

pmc-12985988.title: Gender Disparities in Secondary Patency of Arteriovenous Fistulas: Insights into Hemodialysis Outcomes and Long-Term Vascular Access Viability
pmc-12985988.creator: Lutfi Çagatay Onar, Didem Melis Oztas, Murat Ugurlucan
pmc-12985988.description: Background: Autologous arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs) are the preferred vascular access modality for hemodialysis due to superior durability and lower infection rates. However, long-term secondary functional patency remains a critical determinant of dialysis success and patient survival. Although sex-related differences in vascular access outcomes have been reported, their impact on long-term secondary patency remains insufficiently clarified.

pmc-13074137.title: What If Trojan Horse Nanoparticles Could Change the Game for HPV Gene‐Targeted Therapies?
pmc-13074137.creator: Trairong Chokwassanasakulkit, Vindya Ranasinghe, Erin Woods, Linh Q Nguyen, Nigel A J McMillan
pmc-13074137.description: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is a common sexually transmitted infection linked to various cancers, particularly cervical cancer, primarily driven by high‐risk strains like HPV16 and HPV18. While vaccines are effective in preventing new infections, they do not address existing cases, highlighting the need for innovative therapies. Gene‐targeted approaches, such as CRISPR/Cas and siRNA, show promise in inhibiting HPV oncogenes.

pmc-13261292.title: ‘I Would Feel Failed By the Medical Community Entirely’: Transgender Americans' Calls for Advocacy From Health Professionals in a Care‐Restricted World
pmc-13261292.creator: Kay Wallace, Jayne Reynolds, Jesse Krikorian, Gaines Blasdel, Mary Byrnes, Daphna Stroumsa
pmc-13261292.description: BackgroundGender‐affirming care (GAC) improves the mental health, quality of life, and social functioning of gender‐diverse patients. In spite of this, GAC in the United States (as elsewhere) has become a major focus of debate, with several federal policy changes enacted through Executive Orders and legislation creating major restrictions on transgender (trans) Americans' ability to obtain the care they need.

pmc-13339056.title: Catheter‐Associated Burkholderia cenocepacia Infective Endocarditis in a Patient Receiving Maintenance Hemodialysis
pmc-13339056.creator: Zhong Xhen Khor, Xin Yee Chong, Nor Zanariah Zainol Abidin, Kok Soon Lee
pmc-13339056.description: Burkholderia cenocepacia, a member of the Burkholderia cepacia complex (BCC), is an opportunistic, intrinsically multidrug‐resistant Gram‐negative bacillus most commonly associated with nosocomial outbreaks and chronic pulmonary infection in patients with cystic fibrosis. Endocarditis caused by B. cenocepacia is extremely rare and has been reported mainly in intravenous drug users or in association with prosthetic valves.

pmc-13621564.title: Preliminary study on the cerebral blood flow regulation function in migraine patients using transcranial Doppler ultrasound
pmc-13621564.creator: Yanan Zhang, Hongling Zhao, Furong Li, Junmin Tao, Xin Pan, Shuhan Liu, Weiwei Dong

Compare cerebral blood flow regulation function among migraine patient groups with different grades of right–left shunt (RLS).
